<!-- pr-reviewer: 47626dccdbcf330a192e26ebe5b7ebcbaee2322f -->
**Verdict: Needs changes before merge.** The code is correct and the tests are good. One item is missing from the PR body.

### What looks good

- `handles` in `crates/ui/src/move_drag.rs:172-180` now releases the centre cache when no handle mode can use the part. The guard keeps the cache while Rotate uses the selected, shown part. The lock uses `unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner)`, the same as `shown_center`. There is no `unwrap()` in production code.
- `move_handles::draw` calls `arms_px` and `handles` on each frame from `shell.rs:636`. Thus the release occurs in the app, not only in the tests.
- The six cache tests pin the two sides of the guard: the release, and the Rotate reuse.
- The glyph move to `viewport_bar_glyphs.rs` is a copy of the old arms, with the exception of the new Move arm. The new module has a provenance line. `viewport_bar.rs` has 259 lines and the glyph module has 214 lines.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/2508-move-handle-cleanup.md` records each deferred item of #2508 (shell split, CRLF, formatting). The issue permits this.
- No golden, no snapshot PNG, no process file, no dependency and no `CHANGELOG.md` change. The body has a `Changelog:` line and ends with `Fixes #2508`.

### Results (local, trial merge with upstream/main `8643d9bb7`)

The PR head is on the current main. The trial merge was "Already up to date".

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib --no-run` | build OK |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (two runs) | 1160 passed, 1 failed, 7 ignored |
| failing test, alone | 4 of 4 `setup_mount_pages` tests pass |
| same suite on upstream/main (PR source removed) | 1153 passed, 1 failed (the same test), 7 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

The failing test is `egui_app::tests::setup_mount_pages::each_setup_picks_its_own_machine_and_post_and_posts_one_file_per_mount`. It also fails on main in the full parallel run, and it passes alone. This PR does not cause it. It is not a blocker for this PR.

Mutations (each on the PR head, then restored):

1. Original `move_drag.rs`: the five `center_cache_releases_facets_*` tests fail (`left: 4, right: 3`; deleted part `left: 2, right: 1`). The Rotate reuse test passes. This agrees with the PR body.
2. Guard removed (`if true`, so the cache always clears): `center_cache_keeps_rotate_facets_between_move_handle_passes` fails (`left: 4, right: 1`). The five release tests pass.
3. The Move part rectangle removed from `viewport_bar_glyphs.rs`: `move_glyph_shows_a_part_body_while_pan_shows_only_arrows` fails.

All three mutations are red. Each pin catches its fault.

### Requested before merge

1. **Add before and after screenshots of the viewport bar to the PR body.** The PR changes a visible glyph: the Move button now shows a part with three handles (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/viewport_bar_glyphs.rs:111-128`). The body says "No ... manual visual review". The maintainer must see the old glyph and the new glyph next to Pan. Put the images on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch and link them from the body. Do not commit the images to the PR branch.

### Notes (not blocking)

- The Move glyph uses fixed pixel values (`9.0`, `5.0`, `7.0` and the `(-2.0, 2.0)` offset, `viewport_bar_glyphs.rs:113-123`). The other glyphs scale with `NAV_PX`. If `NAV_PX` changes, this glyph does not scale with the other glyphs. A `NAV_PX` fraction gives the same result at 26 px.
- The flaky `setup_mount_pages` test is on main. It needs an issue of its own.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
